apiErrors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Hari amakuru abura cyangwa atanditse neza.

apiErrors.LOCKED: Wibeshye inshuro nyinshi. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'iminota 15.
apiErrors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Imeyili, nimero ya telefoni cyangwa ijambo ry'ibanga si byo.
apiErrors.ALREADY_EXISTS: Hari konti isanzwe ikoresha iyi meyili cyangwa iyi nimero.
apiErrors.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: Iri suzuma ryari ryoherejwe n'ibisubizo bitandukanye.
apiErrors.FLAG_GUARD: Iki gikorwa kibanza gukenera uruhushya rushya rw'akanama k'imyitwarire.
apiErrors.OFFLINE: Nta interineti ufite. Ihuze wongere ugerageze.
apiErrors.CONSENT_REQUIRED: Banza wemere kwitabira mbere yo gutangira isuzuma.

auth.loginSubtitle: Injira ukoresheje imeyili cyangwa nimero ya telefoni.
auth.signupSubtitle: Hitamo uko uzakoresha Rinda, hanyuma wandike imeyili cyangwa nimero ya telefoni.
auth.identifierInvalid: Andika imeyili cyangwa nimero ya telefoni nyayo.
auth.passwordShort: Ijambo ry'ibanga rigomba kugira nibura inyuguti 8.

roleHelp.participant: Kora isuzuma ry'ubuzima urebe ibisubizo byawe.
roleHelp.facilitator: Kuyobora ibikorwa by'ubushakashatsi no gufasha abitabiriye.
roleHelp.reviewer: Gusuzuma no kwemeza ibikubiyemo byerekeye ubuzima.

callbackErrors.google: Kwinjira ukoresheje Google ntibyarangiye. Ongera ugerageze.
callbackErrors.google_no_account: Nta konti ikoresha iyi meyili ya Google. Banza ufungure konti.
callbackErrors.account_off: Iyi konti yarahagaritswe. Vugana n'itsinda ry'ubushakashatsi.

subtitle.participant: Amasuzuma yawe n'intambwe zikurikira, bibitswe mu ibanga.

dashboard.noSafety: Nta kibazo cy'umutekano mu minsi 30 ishize.
dashboard.deletionRequested: Wadusabye gusiba amakuru yawe. Tuzabirangiza mu minsi 14.

profile.title: Umwirondoro
profile.passwordChanged: Ijambo ry'ibanga ryahinduwe. Izindi telefoni na mudasobwa byasohowe.
profile.aboutHint: Bifasha porogaramu gusobanura bimwe mu bisubizo. Ushobora kubireka uko biri.
profile.deleteTitle: Kuva mu bushakashatsi no gusiba amakuru yanjye
profile.deleteBody: Ushobora kuva mu bushakashatsi igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Tuzasiba amasuzuma yawe n'amakuru yawe mu masaha 72.
profile.deleteConfirm: Urashaka ko dusiba amakuru yawe? Nimara gusibwa ntibishobora gusubizwaho.
profile.consentsBody: Hindura ibi byemezo igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Buri gihinduka kibikwa nk'inyandiko nshya. Kugira ngo uve mu bushakashatsi burundu, saba ko amakuru yawe asibwa hepfo.

checkup.title: Isuzuma ry'ubuzima
checkup.intro: Subiza ibyo ushoboye. Ushobora gusimbuka ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose. Gusimbuka nta ngaruka mbi bigira.

sources.recalled: Ndabyibuka cyangwa ni ibyo napimwe vuba

issues.out_of_range: Iki gipimo gisa n'aho kiri hanze y'urugero rusanzwe. Ongera ukirebe.
issues.weight_check: Ongera urebe ibiro. Bigomba kwandikwa mu kilogarama.
issues.systolic_not_above_diastolic: Umubare wo hejuru ugomba kuruta uwo hasi.

wellness.stopped: Wahagaritse ibibazo by'imitekerereze n'umunaniro. Ushobora kohereza ibindi bisigaye mu isuzuma ryawe.

results.title: Ibisubizo byanjye
results.deleteConfirm: Urashaka gusiba iri suzuma n'ibisubizo byaryo? Ntibishobora gusubizwaho.
results.educational: Ibi bisubizo ni iby'inyigisho, si isuzuma rya muganga. Si serivisi y'ubutabazi bwihuse.
results.keepGoing: Ibyo washubije byose biri mu rugero rwasabwe. Komereza aho.
results.urgent: Umuvuduko w'amaraso wawe uri hejuru cyane. Shaka ubufasha uyu munsi.

targets.activity_split: Iminota igera kuri {{minutesPerDay}} yiyongera mu minsi {{days}} muri iki cyumweru
targets.activity_week: Iminota igera kuri {{minutes}} yiyongera muri iki cyumweru
targets.diet_servings: Ongeraho ibipimo {{servings}} by'imbuto cyangwa imboga ku munsi

results.noStep: Nta mpinduka ikenewe hano. Komereza aho.

help.intro: Serivisi z'ubuntu kandi z'ibanga ushobora guhamagara.

participants.intro: Abitabiriye bagaragazwa gusa n'imeyili cyangwa nimero bihishe igice.

sessions.deleteConfirm: Urashaka gusiba iki gikorwa n'ibisubizo by'imirimo yacyo?

safety.title: Ibibazo by'umutekano
safety.intro: Byandika urwego, icyabiteye n'ibyakozwe gusa, ntibyandika ibisubizo cyangwa amanota.

tiers.2: Urwego rwa 2: agahinda kagaragaye cyangwa kavuzwe
tiers.3: Urwego rwa 3: umugambi cyangwa ubushake, cyangwa ntashobora kwirinda

users.name: Izina
users.deleteConfirm: Urashaka gusiba iyi konti n'amakuru yayo yose? Ntibishobora gusubizwaho.

content.title: Ibikubiyemo
content.intro: Buri verisiyo ikenera kwemezwa n'abantu babiri batandukanye mbere yo gutangazwa.
content.yourDraft: Ni wowe wanditse iyi nyandiko, bityo undi muntu agomba kuyisuzuma.

deletions.title: Ibisabwa byo gusiba amakuru
deletions.intro: Rangiza buri busabe mu masaha 72. Kurangiza bisiba amakuru y'uwitabiriye n'aho twamubona.
deletions.completeConfirm: Urashaka gusiba ubu amasuzuma, umwirondoro n'uburyo bwo kuvugisha uyu witabiriye? Ntibishobora gusubizwaho.

audit.title: Igitabo cy'ibikorwa
audit.intro: Buri gikorwa cy'abakozi, uko byakurikiranye. Ibyanditswe ntibishobora guhindurwa.

flags.title: Ibiranga porogaramu
flags.intro: Fungura cyangwa ufunge ibice bitari ngombwa muri iyi porogaramu. Buri mpinduka irandikwa.

home.heroTitle: Reka twite ku buzima bwawe bwa buri munsi
home.heroSubtitle: Intambwe nto ziriyongera. Dore aho uhagaze uyu munsi.
home.firstCheckup: Tangira isuzuma rigufi. Rimara iminota igera kuri itanu.

guidePanel.title: Baza Rinda
guidePanel.intro: Hitamo ikibazo. Rinda isubiza ishingiye ku bisubizo byawe.
guidePanel.needCheckup: Banza ukore isuzuma kugira ngo Rinda ibashe gusubiza.
guidePanel.offline: Nta interineti ufite, bityo Rinda yasubije ikoresheje inyigisho zemejwe ziri kuri iyi telefoni.

offline.provisionalTitle: Ibisubizo byawe, byabazwe kuri iyi telefoni
offline.provisionalBody: Nta interineti ufite. Ibi bisubizo bizongera kugenzurwa no kubikwa nugaruka kuri interineti.

install.title: Shyira Rinda kuri telefoni
install.body: Shyira Rinda ku rupapuro rw'ibanze rwa telefoni kugira ngo ifunguke nka porogaramu kandi ikore nta interineti.
install.ios: Kuri iPhone: kanda buto yo Gusangiza, hanyuma "Add to Home Screen".

aiOptIn.title: Ibisobanuro bya AI
aiOptIn.body: Emerera serivisi ya AI gusubiramo mu yandi magambo ibisobanuro byemejwe by'ibisubizo byawe. Yakira gusa amagambo n'imibare by'ibisubizo byawe, ntijya yakira izina ryawe, aho twakubona cyangwa ibisubizo by'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe. Ushobora kubihagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
aiOptIn.unavailable: Ibisobanuro bya AI ntibiratangira gukora. Uzakomeza kubona ibisobanuro byemejwe.

emailReports.title: Raporo kuri imeri
emailReports.body: Akira incamake ya buri suzuma kuri imeri: igisubizo cya buri gice n'intambwe imwe nto yo gutangiriraho. Ibisubizo by'imitekerereze n'umunaniro ntibijya byoherezwa. Umuntu wese ushobora gufungura imeri yawe ashobora kuyisoma.
emailReports.toggle: Nyoherereza incamake z'isuzuma ryanjye kuri imeri
emailReports.needEmail: Ibi bisaba konti ifite aderesi ya imeri.
emailReports.sendFailed: Imeri ntiyashoboye koherezwa. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.

consent.needConnection: Rinda ikeneye interineti ubwa mbere, kugira ngo ibike ibyo wemeye. Nyamuneka huza interineti wongere ugerageze.

whatsapp.title: Ubutumwa kuri WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: Akira ubutumwa kuri WhatsApp igihe incamake y'isuzuma ryawe yiteguye. Ubutumwa ntibujya bushyiramo ibisubizo byawe.
whatsapp.needPhone: Ongeraho nimero ya telefoni yawe muri "Amakuru yanjye" kugira ngo ukoreshe ibi.
